_comment: Example only — adapt to your own project. The 'Lumina' product is entirely fictional. Machine-readable companion of handoff-lumina-round-2.md, same handoff_id (ADR-020): the .md carries the narrative for humans, the .json the state for machines.

blockers.description: Certificate supersession semantics undecided: does the original URL keep serving the old document or redirect to the new one

paradas.what_to_approve: Completion metrics computed on read versus incrementally maintained

paradas.what_to_approve: Whether a superseded certificate's original URL serves the old document or redirects
paradas.evidence_required: None beyond the question — it is a product decision, and framing it as technical would mislead
